title: 云路复材与国家重点实验室签署复合材料中试与成型合作协议
titleEn: Yunlu Composites Signs Composite Pilot & Molding Cooperation Agreement with National Key Laboratory
summary: 云路复材与复合材料国家级重点实验室正式签署产学研深度合作协议，双方将在热压罐成型中试平台搭建、真空辅助成型树脂流动模拟等前沿方向展开长期联合技术攻关。
summaryEn: Yunlu Composites 和 the National Key Laboratory for Composite Materials officially signed an in-depth industry-academia-research cooperation agreement, committing to long-term joint R&D in autoclave molding pilot platforms 和 vacuum-assisted resin flow simulation.
content:
云路复材与复合材料国家级重点实验室正式签署产学研深度合作协议，双方将在热压罐成型中试平台搭建、真空辅助成型树脂流动模拟等前沿方向展开长期联合技术攻关。

合作协议在友好热烈的氛围下完成签署。双方将联合成立「先进编织与树脂真空成型联合研发中心」，实验室方面提供前沿材料测试 和 有限元化学流变理论指导，云路复材提供自主研制的 128/256 锭重型工业编织验证平台及高精度真空热压导入中试设备。双方的目标是在未来两年内，攻克厚重壁截面织造物中树脂含浸不均匀、孔隙率偏高这一共性工艺难题，并联合培养复材装备行业的硕博研发人才。
contentEn:
Yunlu Composites 和 the National Key Laboratory for Composite Materials officially signed an in-depth industry-academia-research cooperation agreement, committing to long-term joint R&D in autoclave molding pilot platforms 和 vacuum-assisted resin flow simulation.

The cooperation agreement was signed in a friendly 和 enthusiastic atmosphere. Both parties will jointly establish an 'Advanced Braiding 和 Resin Vacuum Molding Joint R&D Center', with the laboratory providing cutting-edge material testing 和 finite element chemical rheology theoretical guidance, while Yunlu Composites provides its independently developed 128/256-spindle heavy industrial braiding verification platform 和 high-precision vacuum hot-press pilot equipment. The goal is to overcome the common process challenges of uneven resin impregnation 和 high porosity in thick-wall braided components within two years, while jointly cultivating master's 和 doctoral R&D talent for the composite equipment industry.
